name: GlobalSumEmbedding
description: Converts a conjunction of local pairwise inequality constraints into a single global sum constraint (sum of squared differences equals m). Since the domain is {1, 2}, the maximum contribution of each pair is 1; thus, the sum reaches m if and only if every local inequality is satisfied. This prevents models from pattern-matching local rules to graph edges, framing the task as a continuous-looking optimization problem instead.
